The rain moved over the city in a slow gray sheet. Every storefront light reflected in the street as if the pavement had learned to glow. By midnight the storm had passed, and the silence felt newly built.
"You heard that?" Maya asked.
"I heard all of it," Devon said, lowering the book.
"Then say it back to me, exactly."
He did, and for a second the room felt smaller than a sentence.
